card.text: Small moon of Didymos, target of the first asteroid deflection test.

sources.label: NASA · DART impact changed asteroid’s motion in space
sources.quote: the investigation team has confirmed the spacecraft's impact altered Dimorphos' orbit around Didymos by 32 minutes, shortening the 11 hour and 55-minute orbit to 11 hours and 23 minutes.

introduction.text: NASA's DART spacecraft struck Dimorphos on 26 September 2022. The impact shortened its orbit around Didymos by 32 minutes.

sources.label: NASA · DART impact changed asteroid’s motion in space
sources.quote: the investigation team has confirmed the spacecraft's impact altered Dimorphos' orbit around Didymos by 32 minutes, shortening the 11 hour and 55-minute orbit to 11 hours and 23 minutes.

shape.title: SPC shape model v004
shape.summary: Shape from DART and LICIACube images taken before impact, including modeled terrain; not a map of the moon today.

draco.title: DART approach photographs
draco.summary: Four DRACO frames from 11 to 1.8 seconds before impact, brightness-matched; photographed shadows remain.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Height above or below a 75 m sphere, from the shape before impact.

albedo.title: SPC relative albedo model
albedo.summary: Modeled brightness before impact, not absolute albedo; accepted facets cover about 31% of the surface.

slope.title: Modeled surface slopes
slope.summary: Slope against modeled gravity, including rotation and the pull of Didymos, on the pre-impact shape.
